title: Rockstar Mods Real Life Vehicles to Look Like GTA 6 Cars in Miami
description: According to IGN Games, Rockstar Games is rolling out a wild marketing push for GTA 6, featuring real-life modded cars driving through Miami.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Mods Real Life Vehicles to Look Like GTA 6 Cars in Miami

According to a recent report by **IGN Games**, Rockstar Games' ambitious marketing campaign for *Grand Theft Auto VI* (GTA 6) is well underway. In their latest promotional push, the studio has taken real-life vehicles, modified them to look like cars from GTA 6, and driven them directly through the streets of Miami.

### Bringing the Game to the Real World

Miami serves as the direct spiritual inspiration for the setting of GTA 6. By putting modified cars that mimic the game's aesthetic onto the real-world roads of Miami, Rockstar is successfully blurring the lines between virtual gaming and physical reality. This creative real-world activation has caught the attention of everyday pedestrians and generated immense buzz across the global gaming community.

### A Massive Marketing Push

As anticipation for GTA 6 reaches unprecedented levels, Rockstar continues to ramp up its promotional strategies. While official details regarding the full scope of this marketing campaign remain limited, these street-level sightings prove that the studio's promotional rollout is in full swing, keeping the excitement around the franchise at an all-time high.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar has always excelled at unconventional, high-impact marketing. Driving customized vehicles through the streets of Miami is a brilliant nod to the game's setting and a fantastic way to capture public attention. It is a clever, immersive tactic that builds even more anticipation for what is shaping up to be the biggest entertainment launch in history.
